comparison.objective: Recovers a crawler by steering it around a wall using only its tether; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Indirect deformable-tether manipulation and obstacle steering differ from bimanual rigid-tool impact and millimetre fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Crawler must enter the taped zone without contact, collision, or tip-over and the tether be released; candidate requires four contained fractures without insert or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Both include damage avoidance, but the tested physical abilities and outcomes are otherwise materially different.
